comment: Suppressions for `dabbler-uat-dsl validate` errors that the catalog cannot fix without re-crawling new routes or extending the W0 validator. Each entry pairs a route x error-kind to a rationale. The W0 CLI honors this file natively via the `--suppressions <path>` flag (shipped in W0 1.2.0, `w0-cli-suppressions-and-role-pinning` Session 1); matched errors are downgraded from `errors` to `warnings` in the JSON output and `compile` proceeds to emit code when every remaining error is matched. The W2 runner (`ai-router/uat_runner/runner.py`) passes `--suppressions tools/uat-suppressions.json` to W0 on every compile call so emitted .cs is produced and `dotnet test` runs end-to-end.

suppressions.rationale: Click-driven navigation (CLICK LINK, CLICK MENU ITEM, CLICK TAB) does not advance W0's route cursor, producing cascading UnknownRoute errors after the first click-driven transition. All quoted labels were selected verbatim from docs/component-catalog/index.json for the route x role active at each step. The majority of UAT steps for this set are judgment items (catalog was crawled before the rename and before the new cross-link controls were added); a re-crawl after the session closes will update the catalog and allow future sets to use these labels without suppressions.

The catalog was crawled before this session's UI changes: (1) the /admin/users heading 'User Administration' was renamed to 'Manage Organization Admins'; (2) the dashboard info banner (data-testid=user-admin-dashboard-banner) and org-admin cross-link banner (data-testid=user-role-assignment-manage-org-admins-banner) are new controls. All new-label steps are marked IsJudgmentItem=true with rationale. A catalog re-crawl after this session will add the new labels; at that point this suppression should be narrowed or removed.

The checklist uses VERIFY ELEMENT for labels that appear in the catalog as elementRole=Text ('Manage Organization Admins'), elementRole=Link ('Open the Security Dashboard...' banner link), and elementRole=Button ('GRANT USERADMIN'). These are valid elements on the correct routes for the correct role. The VERIFY ELEMENT verb's strict elementRole=Element requirement is intentionally relaxed here because: (a) the Text/Link/Button distinctions do not affect the human verification goal (the human can see whether the text or button is present regardless of its ARIA role); (b) the Playwright emitter's VERIFY ELEMENT implementation confirms visibility of the matching label regardless of elementRole; and (c) using verb-specific forms (VERIFY TEXT, VERIFY LINK, VERIFY BUTTON) for each elementRole would require extending the DSL. Aligns with the existing w0-cli smoke set ElementTypeMismatch suppression rationale.

The smoke's final step verifies `"Available"` is visible after the watermark exercises. The `"Available"` label exists in the /admin/products × SystemAdmin catalog as a `Column` elementRole (the grid column header). The W0 validator flags `VERIFY ELEMENT with label "Available"` because `Element` ≠ `Column` in the type taxonomy, but a column header IS a user-visible element on the page. Using the structured-VERIFY form keeps the assertion deterministic in the emitted Playwright `.cs`; suppressing the type mismatch is narrower than weakening the validator's element-role taxonomy.

The component-catalog crawler authenticates via `SeededSessionAuth` BEFORE crawling — by design, pre-auth routes (`/login`) and dev-only inboxes (`/dev/email-inbox`) are not in the catalog. UAT items that exercise the magic-link sign-in flow MUST reference these routes; the labels used (`Email address`, `Send sign-in link`, `the most-recent email row`) are carried forward from the prior UAT run with human approval. To eliminate this suppression in the future: either (a) extend the crawler with a pre-auth pass that crawls `/login` and `/dev/email-inbox` without seeded session, or (b) treat sign-in plumbing as 'test infrastructure' allowed outside catalog grounding.

The W0 SemanticValidator only updates its `currentRoute` cursor on `NAVIGATE TO` statements. Click-driven navigation (CLICK LINK, CLICK MENU ITEM, CLICK ROW that lands on a detail page) does NOT propagate the new route to the validator, so downstream steps continue to be evaluated against the prior `currentRoute`. For UAT scenarios that mirror real human navigation (no manual URL typing) this produces cascading UnknownRoute errors after the first click-driven transition. Until W0 either (a) infers route transitions from click semantics, or (b) accepts a `VERIFY URL matches "..."` as a route-cursor-update sigil, click-driven UAT scripts are accepted with this category-wide suppression. The labels themselves (catalog grounding) are correct — every quoted label, caption, tab, and column header in the post-auth steps was selected verbatim from `docs/component-catalog/index.json` for the route x role active at that step. This is the proof-of-concept the `component-catalog-grounded-authorship` set was meant to land.

The component-catalog crawler authenticates via SeededSessionAuth before crawling — pre-auth routes (/login) and dev-only inboxes (/dev/email-inbox) are not in the catalog. UAT items that exercise the magic-link sign-in flow must reference these routes. Labels ('Email address', 'Send sign-in link') are the standard magic-link login pattern used across prior UAT sets.

W0's route cursor only advances on NAVIGATE TO statements. Click-driven navigation (CLICK TAB 'USERS AND ROLE ASSIGNMENT', CLICK BUTTON 'Add User', CLICK LINK to email-inbox) does not advance the cursor, producing cascading UnknownRoute errors. All quoted labels were selected verbatim from the catalog or from the just-implemented source code for the route x role active at each step.

The new 'Add User' button and all CreateBackofficeUserDialog controls (Display Name, Email, Initial Role, Initial Organization, Cancel, Create User) are not in the catalog because: (a) the 'Add User' button is on the Users and Role Assignment tab which is behind a tab click and not the default tab crawled at /admin/security; (b) dialog controls are only visible after the dialog is opened and are never in the catalog. All labels are verified verbatim from source code (CreateBackofficeUserDialog.razor, UsersAndRoleAssignmentTab.razor). A catalog re-crawl that navigates to the tab will add the button; dialog controls will require a future W0 extension.

Some catalog entries (tab labels, column headers, text elements) are referenced via CLICK/VERIFY verbs that expect a different elementRole than the catalog records. The user-visible label and the associated interaction goal are correct; the elementRole taxonomy difference does not affect the human verification goal or the Playwright emitter's ability to locate and interact with the element.

Best-effort W0 pass for this set is accepted. The UAT/E2E correctness proof for admin-user-creation-flow is the hand-rolled Playwright [Fact] tests (not the W0-compiled output) because the W0 runner's auto-inserted SeededSignInAsync conflicts with the DSL-driven magic-link login in Steps[]. All grammar-level, catalog-level, and route-cursor errors are suppressed so the W0 compiler can emit a best-effort .cs; the hand-rolled Playwright tests (AdminUserCreationFlowUatTests.cs) are the authoritative correctness backstop per project-guidance option (a) for this runner-conflict scenario.

Pre-catalog checklists; closed sets; not retroactively updated. These checklists were authored before `component-catalog-grounded-authorship` shipped the catalog + `uat-script-author` task type. They contain free-form labels and DSL violations that pre-date the catalog ground truth. Re-authoring would require re-running each set's UAT, which is not the right cost trade. New UAT checklists must use `route(task_type="uat-script-author")` per the `Catalog-Grounded UAT Script Authoring` Convention in `docs/planning/project-guidance.md`.
